title: Document checklist
description: Documents, versions and review status of the final submission package.

readiness.title: Package readiness
readiness.label: Package readiness percentage
readiness.qcNote: The program coordinator records the QC result; the readiness percentage is not an automatic decision.

groups.CORE: The core of the application package — all required.
groups.ANNEX: Visual and technical material showing the prototype, architecture and workflow.
groups.CONDITIONAL: Added only when real, verifiable evidence exists.

final_form.title: Final application form
final_form.hint: The completed and checked final version of the official application form on the competition platform.

budget_plan.title: Budget plan
budget_plan.hint: Table of components, services and other costs, with totals and price sources.

commitment_form.title: Commitment form
commitment_form.hint: Participation and commitment form signed by every team member.

test_evidence.title: Test evidence
test_evidence.hint: Test protocol proving the prototype works: date, conditions, measured results and photo/video evidence.

demo_video.title: Demo video
demo_video.hint: A 2–3 minute video of the prototype actually working; no results staged through editing.

prototype_visuals.title: Prototype visuals
prototype_visuals.hint: Photos and screenshots that reflect the real state of the prototype.

architecture_diagram.title: System architecture diagram
architecture_diagram.hint: Diagram of components, data flow and integrations.

workflow_diagram.title: Workflow diagram
workflow_diagram.hint: Diagram of the sequence of user and system steps.

technical_drawing.title: Technical drawing / schematic
technical_drawing.hint: Mechanical drawing, electrical schematic or PCB layout. Mark as confidential if it contains patentable detail.

references.title: References
references.hint: Scientific sources, standards and open datasets used.

survey_results.title: Survey results
survey_results.hint: Include only if a real survey was conducted: state the method, date, number of participants and raw results.

support_letter.title: Support letter
support_letter.hint: Only letters signed by the partner who has given permission to use them. No unsigned or team-drafted letters.

patent_info.title: Patent information
patent_info.hint: Only with an official application or registration number. Trade secrets never go into public pitch material.

guide.title: Which annexes fit?
guide.fit1: Prototype visuals — real photos and screenshots
guide.cond1: Survey results — with method, date, participants and raw results
guide.cond2: Support letter — signed by the partner, with permission
guide.cond3: Patent information — with an official application or registration number
guide.never: Fabricated or inflated evidence is never added.
guide.confidentialBody: Trade secrets and patentable material are marked “confidential”, kept separate from public pitch material and hidden from the jury.
guide.juryConfidential: Material marked confidential is not shown in the jury view. Only public submission material is listed here.
guide.rulesBody: Max {size}. PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP, MP4, ZIP, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT. Every upload creates a new version and is written to the audit log.

upload.title: Upload document
upload.description: Version v{n} of {item} will be created.
upload.fileHint: Max {size} · PDF, image, MP4, ZIP, Office or TXT
upload.confidentialHint: Hidden from the jury and never part of public pitch material.
upload.conditionalWarning: Conditional annex: upload only real, verifiable evidence.

review.title: Review document
review.rejectHint: The team must upload a corrected version.
review.noteHint: A note is required when requesting changes: what must change?

add.title: New checklist item
add.description: An additional document required for this project. The action is audited.

delete.label: Delete version v{n}
delete.title: Delete this version?
delete.description: The file {name} (v{n}) will be removed from the server. This cannot be undone and is written to the audit log.

errors.invalid: The submitted data is not valid.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.fileType: This file type is not accepted.
errors.noteRequired: Describe the required changes (at least 3 characters).
errors.nothingToReview: There is no file to review.
errors.titleShort: The title must have at least 3 characters.
errors.titleLong: The title is too long (max 140 characters).

overview.title: Documents
overview.descriptionAdmin: Submission package readiness of every team, the review queue and missing documents.
overview.descriptionMentor: Document readiness and review queue of the projects assigned to you.
